reason: Reuters confirms that Davies will miss Canada's opener and says the attacking burden falls largely on all-time leading scorer Jonathan David. David therefore rises modestly, while Davies retains only a small route through a later group match if Canada fails to score against Bosnia.

Pedro Neto scored Portugal's opening warm-up goal against Nigeria and Francisco Conceicao scored the winner. Ronaldo remains the favorite because he started centrally, played longer than every other starting outfielder, and received two clear one-on-one chances, but Neto and Conceicao replace less directly supported forwards.

Musab Al Juwayr produced one of Saudi Arabia's clearest chances while playing in the strong first-half lineup against Senegal, after a pass from Salem Al Dawsari. He enters the shortlist without displacing Al Dawsari as the captain, penalty threat, and attack's named star.

Messi returned from his hamstring soreness, said he felt great, immediately created the penalty he converted, and supplied the pass before Argentina's third goal against Iceland. Rodrigo De Paul directly assisted that third goal and enters the slate as a demonstrated creator.
